summary: Only one callback can own console output. To replace the default, the plugin sets CALLBACK_TYPE = stdout and you set stdout_callback in ansible.cfg, for example dense or a custom one. This applies to ansible-playbook by default.
questions: How do I change ansible-playbook's output to the dense format?
Can I have two stdout callbacks at once?
What does my custom callback need to replace the default output?

answer_card.title: Changing the stdout callback
answer_card.answer_md:
Only one stdout callback can be active. The plugin must define `CALLBACK_TYPE = stdout`. Then set it in `ansible.cfg`:

```ini
stdout_callback = dense
```

This affects `ansible-playbook` by default. Ad hoc commands need an extra setting.
